name: Sea Coast and Coastal Filler Rooms

rooms.name: An Ocean Inlet
rooms.desc:
Coastal waters slow as they gently strike the surf to both the west and
north.  The ocean spans to the southern horizon while the dry land of the
coast lies northwest of you.

rooms.name: Ocean Shallows
rooms.desc:
You are wading in the shallows of the ocean beach.  Water surrounds you,
growing colder and deeper to the south.  Dry land lies to the north and 
west, where you can hear gulls squawking.

rooms.name: Coastal Shallows
rooms.desc:
You are surrounded by water on all sides, though the coast lies a short
distance to the northwest.  Here the water seems warm as current from the
south flow northward and heat the area.

rooms.name: Ocean Shallows
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the shallows of an ocean beach.  Brine wafts up,
stinging your nose as it is carried along with the thick seawater.
   The ocean grows deeper to the south and east, but touches land to the
northwest and west.

rooms.name: Ocean Waters
rooms.desc:

northwest.  Here the water seems warm as currents from the south flow into the
area to make the air warm and turbulent.

rooms.name: A Small, Rocky Cove
rooms.desc:
You are wading in the shallows of a small cove.  A few trees hang overhead,
casting shadows on the briny water around you and the strands of algae that
entwine themselves around your feet.
   To the north and west you can see shrubs dry, rocky outcroppings along the
coast, while to the south and east, the ocean extends far to the edge of your
vision.  To the northwest, the cove enters a thick canopy of trees.

rooms.name: Briny Waters
rooms.desc:
You float in the briny waters just south of a sea swamp, where the
mire meets the ocean.  A few dead logs float by into the open sea to
the south and west, while you can see movement of swamp animals to the
north and northwest.

rooms.name: Salty Waters
rooms.desc:
You float in the waters just south of a briny swamp, where the salty
waters of the northern swamp mingle with the tangy ocean.  Flotsam and a
few reeds of sea plants float by from the ocean to the east and northeast,
while a calm bay seems to open to the distant south.
